# SEO Reading

> A Reading-based search marketing consultancy serving Berkshire and the Thames Valley. Local SEO, technical SEO, and AI search optimisation for businesses in Reading, Caversham, Tilehurst, Earley, Woodley, Wokingham, Bracknell, Newbury, and Thatcham.
